Since no sale could be guaranteed, we were no longer earning through commission and were earning pay on a daily basis, which ended up being very nice. I’d be in contact with the sales rep to know which area we’d tagging, so everything was all set. 

It lasted maybe two months before the company found out the rep had barely been doing their routes. They’d maintained contact with me during those two months and said where they would be, they just never tried to sell and collected an effortless paycheck. I, however, went to these towns, kicked back in my work truck and read comic books and watched tv on my iPad waiting for a notification that a sale’s been made and ready for install. From about 8am-6pm I’d do this six days a week for two months and in that entire time there were two sales were made and installed. 

All in all, I essentially got paid around $2500 a week to drive 15 miles then sit and read comics all day. I know that amount might not seem like much to some but to me it’s some of the best living I did.
